name: 97215 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97215 (Portland) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97215 (Portland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97215 (Portland) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
